question: The largest river system of Rajasthan is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Luni**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The largest river system of Rajasthan is **Luni**.
 
• The Luni River originates from the Pushkar valley of the Aravalli Range, near Ajmer, and flows towards the west and southwest, covering a length of about 495 km.
